hero.title: Who is Dr. Julieth Vanessa Medina?
hero.p1: Julieth Vanessa Medina is a Colombian physician passionate about wellbeing and natural beauty. Since her early years working in hospitals, she discovered that her true calling was aesthetic medicine — where science, art and empathy meet to bring out each person's best version.
hero.p2: Over time she opened her own clinic, a space designed to offer trust, natural results and treatments with state-of-the-art technology.
hero.quote: “Authenticity, sophistication and elegance are the new era of Aesthetic Medicine. Investing in yourself should be about highlighting what makes you unique — a real beauty, without excess.” —

vision.title: Mission & Vision
vision.missionText: To provide integral aesthetic medical care focused on the patient's wellbeing and harmony, using advanced technology and a human approach for natural, lasting results.
vision.visionText: To be a national and international reference in ethical, innovative and responsible aesthetic medicine — inspiring more professionals and patients to adopt a healthy, conscious view of beauty.
